## Epic

E<n> - <title> (`docs/epics/E<n>-<slug>.md`), risk class: low | normal | high. A bug fix names BUG-<n> from `docs/BUGS.md` instead.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1: what covers it (test or QA scenario)

## Decisions

ADRs this PR follows or adds.

## Not done

What the change asked for and this PR does not deliver, and why.

## Review

The code reviewer's file: `docs/reviews/E<n>-<slug>.md` or `docs/reviews/BUG-<n>.md`.

## Checks

- [ ] `scripts/gate --full` is green
- [ ] `ai-review` was set by the review flow, not by hand
